{"consolidated_memory":"## Partial Upload Issues in storage/blob/uploader.rs (Multiple Occasions)

**Component**: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side, Rust)
**Common Signal**: Final part of upload never gets acknowledged
**Common Repro**: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
**Common Test Location**: Module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-26] OAuth Provider Sessions
- **Trigger**: Only occurred for sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- **Root Cause**: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- **Fix**: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
  - PR #1085 on branch fix/partial-upload-1
- **Result**: Error rate dropped from 9.4% to under 2 per 10,000

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-13] Rollout Bucket Issue
- **Trigger**: Only occurred for accounts in the 5% rollout bucket
- **Root Cause**: A listener registered but never removed
- **Fix**: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
  - PR #8352 on branch fix/partial-upload-3
- **Result**: Job completion improved from 1 hour to 54 minutes

### Occasion 3: [2026-07-20] Race Condition on Cached Key
- **Trigger**: Occurred when two requests raced on the same key
- **Root Cause**: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- **Fix**: Invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
  - PR #9697 on branch fix/partial-upload-4
- **Result**: Reclaimed 21 GB of blob storage"}
